topics.title: Faith & trust
topics.description: Trust God when the way ahead is uncertain. Read Bible devotions about courage, doubt, and holding to His promises.

topics.title: Prayer
topics.description: Bring your fears, questions, and gratitude to God. These devotions explore honest prayer and dependence on Him.

topics.title: Hope & encouragement
topics.description: Find encouragement in accounts of people who met God in loss, loneliness, danger, and discouragement.

topics.title: Forgiveness & grace
topics.description: Reflect on the mercy of Jesus, the invitation to repent, and the grace that welcomes us back to God.

topics.title: Wisdom & discernment
topics.description: Learn from Scripture about listening well, testing what we hear, and making choices with humility.

topics.title: Humility & obedience
topics.description: Consider what it means to receive God’s Word, surrender pride, and follow Him in everyday decisions.

topics.title: Love & service
topics.description: Explore practical compassion, generosity, peacemaking, and faith expressed through care for other people.

topics.title: Waiting on God
topics.description: Read about patient faith when answers take time, circumstances remain difficult, or the next step is unclear.

devotions.title: Remember the Creator
devotions.subject: Creation and the first Sabbath
devotions.keyVerse: “And God blessed the seventh day and declared it holy, because it was the day when he rested from all his work of creation.”
devotions.summary: Creation reveals whose world this is and whose we are. Reflect on human dignity, stewardship, and the seventh-day Sabbath as God’s gift.

videos.title: He Blessed One Day and Called It Holy.

devotions.title: The Serpent, the Fruit and the First Hiding
devotions.subject: Temptation, shame, and the God who comes looking for us
devotions.keyVerse: “Then the LORD God called to the man, ‘Where are you?’”
devotions.summary: Genesis 3 traces temptation, shame, hiding, and blame—then reveals the God who comes looking for us and speaks hope before the sentence is finished.

videos.title: A Question Came Before the Fruit.

devotions.title: Enoch: Walking With God
devotions.subject: Enoch’s life of faith and close fellowship with God
devotions.keyVerse: “Enoch lived 365 years, walking in close fellowship with God. Then one day he disappeared, because God took him.”
devotions.summary: Enoch’s brief biography is defined by close fellowship with God. Reflect on faith, ordinary daily obedience, courageous witness, and hope in Christ’s return.

videos.title: Four Verses. Said Twice.

devotions.title: Building Without God
devotions.subject: The tower on the plain of Shinar
devotions.keyVerse: “Come, let’s build a great city for ourselves with a tower that reaches into the sky.”
devotions.summary: Reflect on the tower of Babel in Genesis 11 and the difference between building a name for ourselves and trusting God.

videos.title: When The Lord Came Down
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: The Call of Abram: Following God by Faith
devotions.subject: Abram answers God’s call and trusts His promise
devotions.keyVerse: “So Abram departed as the LORD had instructed”
devotions.summary: God spoke first, and Abram went before he could see the whole road. Reflect on trusting God’s promise, worship along the way, and the blessing that reaches others through Christ.

videos.title: Would You Go Without Knowing Where?

devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for speaking first and for keeping Your promises. When I cannot see the road, help me trust You and obey what I already know. Thank You, Lord Jesus, for the blessing You won for me on the cross. Keep me close to You, and let Your love reach others through my life. Amen.

devotions.title: Is Anything Too Hard for the Lord?
devotions.subject: Abraham welcomes three visitors and Sarah hears God's promise
devotions.keyVerse: “Is anything too hard for the LORD? I will return about this time next year, and Sarah will have a son.”
devotions.summary: Sarah laughed when God's promise seemed impossible. Reflect on Abraham's hospitality, God's faithfulness through waiting, and the hope that reaches us in Christ.

videos.title: She Laughed at God's Promise. Then It Came True.

devotions.prayer: Faithful God, nothing is too hard for You. Give me a humble, generous heart to welcome others. When I doubt, help me bring my questions to You, and teach me to trust what You have truly promised. In Jesus’ name, amen.

devotions.title: Abraham Intercedes for Sodom
devotions.subject: Abraham pleads for Sodom in humble, persistent prayer
devotions.keyVerse: “Should not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?”
devotions.summary: Abraham drew near to God and pleaded for Sodom. Reflect on justice, mercy, persistent prayer, and Jesus, who intercedes for us.

videos.title: Abraham Intercedes for Sodom

devotions.prayer: Righteous and merciful God, You are the Judge of all the earth, and You always do what is right. Give me Abraham’s humble, caring heart. Help me reject sin, love people, and keep praying for those who are far from You. Thank You for Jesus, my great Intercessor, who gave His life for sinners. Amen.

devotions.title: Led by God: The Servant Finds Rebekah at the Well
devotions.subject: Abraham’s servant finds Rebekah at the well
devotions.keyVerse: “‘Praise the LORD, the God of my master, Abraham,’ he said. ‘The LORD has shown unfailing love and faithfulness to my master, for he has led me straight to my master’s relatives.’”
devotions.summary: At the well, Abraham’s servant prays for guidance and Rebekah responds with willing kindness. Reflect on prayer, discernment, gratitude, and serving in response to Christ’s love.
devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for Your unfailing love and faithfulness. Guide my decisions, and help me wait patiently when the answer is slow. Help me notice the needs of others and respond with a willing heart. Thank You for Jesus, who gave His life for me. Amen.

videos.title: She Offered Water. God Was Already at Work.
Prayed, but Still Unsure? How God Led Rebekah | Genesis 24

devotions.title: Do Not Trade the Eternal for the Temporary
devotions.subject: Esau sells his birthright
devotions.keyVerse: “Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and lentil stew. Esau ate the meal, then got up and left. He showed contempt for his rights as the firstborn.”
devotions.summary: Esau’s birthright in Genesis 25 invites us to consider how today’s desires shape our choices and what we value most.

videos.title: One Meal Cost Him Everything

devotions.title: God’s Promise Does Not Need Our Deception
devotions.subject: Jacob and Rebekah deceive Isaac
devotions.keyVerse: “But Isaac said, ‘Your brother was here, and he tricked me. He has taken away your blessing.’”
devotions.summary: Jacob and Rebekah’s deception in Genesis 27 challenges us to trust God’s promises without trying to secure them through dishonesty.

videos.title: He Used God's Name to Cover a Lie

devotions.title: Jacob’s Ladder at Bethel: God Meets Us in Our Lonely Places
devotions.subject: Jacob’s dream at Bethel and God’s promise of His presence
devotions.keyVerse: “What’s more, I am with you, and I will protect you wherever you go. One day I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have finished giving you everything I have promised you.”
devotions.summary: God meets Jacob on a lonely night at Bethel. Reflect on God’s presence, the grace of Jesus who brings us to God, and our response of grateful faith.
devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for being with Jacob in his loneliness and for being with me in mine. Forgive my sins through Jesus and help me trust that You are near. Thank You for opening the way to You through Christ. Help me respond to Your grace with a grateful heart. Amen.

videos.title: He Deceived His Father. Why Did God Still Meet Him?

devotions.title: Jacob's Breeding Program: When God Blesses the Work of Our Hands
devotions.subject: Jacob’s flocks, Laban’s changing wages, and God’s care through unfair treatment
devotions.keyVerse: “For I have seen how Laban has treated you.”
devotions.summary: Jacob works faithfully while Laban repeatedly changes his wages. Reflect on God’s providence, honest work, fair treatment, and the care of Christ, the Good Shepherd.

videos.title: His Wages Changed 10 Times. God Saw It All. | Jacob

devotions.prayer: Lord, thank You for seeing what others miss. Thank You for the work You give me and the strength to do it. Help me to work honestly and to treat others fairly. When I am treated unfairly, give me wisdom, patience and courage. Keep me from trusting my own plans more than I trust You. Jesus, Good Shepherd, carry me when I am weak, and teach me to care for others as You care for me. Amen.

devotions.title: Holding On to God at Peniel
devotions.subject: Jacob wrestles at Peniel
devotions.keyVerse: “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”
devotions.summary: Jacob’s night at Peniel invites us to bring our fears to God, persist in prayer, and receive the grace that changes how we live.

videos.title: He Would Not Let Go of God | Jacob at Peniel

devotions.title: When Envy Takes Root
devotions.subject: Joseph's brothers and the robe
devotions.keyVerse: “But his brothers hated Joseph because their father loved him more than the rest of them. They couldn’t say a kind word to him.”
devotions.summary: Joseph’s brothers in Genesis 37 reveal how envy harms relationships. Reflect on gratitude, honesty, and love within the family.

videos.title: Check Your Soil Today
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: Faithful to God, Whatever the Cost: Joseph in Egypt
devotions.subject: Joseph’s integrity, temptation, and God’s presence in unjust suffering
devotions.keyVerse: “How could I do such a wicked thing? It would be a great sin against God.”
devotions.summary: Joseph honours God but faces false accusation and prison. Reflect on integrity, wise and safe action, and the faithful love of God before circumstances change.

videos.title: He Said No. Then Came Prison.

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for Your mercy and faithful love. Forgive our chosen sins, and help us honour You in public and in private. Give us wisdom to take safe steps and courage to seek help. Comfort and protect those who have been wronged. Keep us from revenge, and help us trust Your care before our circumstances change. Amen.

devotions.title: Bread from Heaven: Trusting God One Day at a Time
devotions.subject: Manna, Sabbath rest, and Jesus the Bread of Life
devotions.keyVerse: “Look, I’m going to rain down food from heaven for you.”
devotions.summary: In the wilderness, God gave Israel bread one day at a time and Sabbath rest as a gift. Jesus reveals Himself as the Bread of Life. Reflect on trusting God today, receiving Christ, and sharing what you have.

videos.title: Bread That Spoiled Overnight—Except Once a Week

devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for caring for us day by day. When tomorrow feels uncertain, teach us to trust You with today. Draw us to Jesus, the Bread of Life, and help us receive His grace. Give us wisdom to rest in Your care and generous hearts to share with people in need. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

devotions.title: Water from the Rock at Horeb: Christ Our Living Rock
devotions.subject: Israel's thirst, God's mercy, and Christ the living Rock
devotions.keyVerse: “Strike the rock, and water will come gushing out. Then the people will be able to drink.”
devotions.summary: At Horeb, God gave water to a thirsty people despite their doubt. Remember His faithfulness and bring your thirst to Christ, the living Rock.

videos.title: They Tested God. He Still Gave Them Water.

devotions.prayer: Faithful God, thank You for carrying me. In dry places, help me remember Your care and bring my needs to You honestly. Lord Jesus, thank You for being the true Rock. Satisfy my thirst with Your grace, and teach me to trust that You are with us. Amen.

devotions.title: When Hands Grow Weary: The Lord Is Our Banner
devotions.subject: Moses, Aaron, Hur, and Joshua: prayer, shared burdens, and the Lord our banner
devotions.keyVerse: “Moses built an altar there and named it Yahweh-Nissi (which means ‘the LORD is my banner’).”
devotions.summary: When Moses’ arms grow weary, Aaron and Hur support him while Joshua fights below. Reflect on prayer, faithful work, sharing burdens, and giving the glory to God.

videos.title: His Arms Gave Out. His Friends Didn't.

devotions.prayer: LORD, You are our banner. When the struggle is greater than we can bear, teach us to look to You first and give us courage to do the work You have placed in our hands. Open our eyes to the people around us whose arms are tired, and make us faithful helpers who stay by their side. When we are weary, give us grace to receive help. Thank You, Jesus, for praying for us without growing tired. Make us one in Your love, and let all the glory be Yours. Amen.

devotions.title: Show Me Your Glory
devotions.subject: Moses seeks God’s presence and glory, and God reveals His goodness and character
devotions.keyVerse: “Then show me your glorious presence.” The Lord replied, “I will make all my goodness pass before you.”
devotions.summary: Moses asks to see God’s glory, and God reveals His goodness, compassion, and faithful love. Reflect on seeking God’s presence, knowing His heart through Jesus, and being changed by His Spirit.

videos.title: He Asked to See God. Here’s What God Showed Him

devotions.prayer: Lord God, like Moses, we ask You to show us Your glory. Thank You for revealing Yourself as compassionate and merciful, slow to anger and filled with unfailing love. Thank You for showing us Your heart in Jesus, who gave Himself for us. Shelter us in Him and draw us close to You. Transform us by Your Spirit, so that others may see Your goodness in our lives. Go with us and with those we love. In Jesus’ name we pray. Amen.

devotions.title: The Lord Heard Them
devotions.subject: Miriam and Aaron criticise Moses, and Moses prays for Miriam’s healing
devotions.keyVerse: “So Moses cried out to the Lord, ‘O God, I beg you, please heal her!’”
devotions.summary: Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses, and the Lord hears them. Reflect on jealousy hidden in criticism, responding with humility, and praying for those who have hurt us as God works to restore His people.

videos.title: His Sister Hurt Him. He Prayed for Her. | Moses & Miriam

devotions.prayer: Lord, You hear every word we speak. Forgive us when disappointment turns into criticism, and help us to see what is really in our hearts. Keep us from looking down on others because of their nationality or family background. When others speak against us, teach us to respond with humility and to entrust our reputation to You. Give us grace to pray for those who have hurt us. Thank You for Jesus, who healed the sick with a touch and still intercedes for us. When we wander, draw us back to You, and unite us as one family in Him. In Jesus’ name we pray. Amen.

devotions.title: Whose Report Will You Believe?
devotions.subject: The twelve spies and the same land
devotions.keyVerse: “And if the Lord is pleased with us, he will bring us safely into that land and give it to us. It is a rich land flowing with milk and honey. Do not rebel against the Lord, and don’t be afraid of the people of the land. They are only helpless prey to us! They have no protection, but the Lord is with us! Don’t be afraid of them!”
devotions.summary: The twelve spies saw the same land. Reflect on Numbers 13–14 and the courage to trust God when fear shapes the story.

videos.title: Faith Sees God, Not Giants
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: When Discontent Becomes Rebellion
devotions.subject: Korah, Dathan and Abiram
devotions.keyVerse: “Does it seem insignificant to you that the God of Israel has chosen you from among all the community of Israel to be near him so you can serve in the Lord’s Tabernacle and stand before the people to minister to them? Korah, he has already given this special ministry to you and your fellow Levites. Are you now demanding the priesthood as well?”
devotions.summary: Korah’s rebellion in Numbers 16 invites reflection on pride, gratitude, and serving faithfully in the place God has given us.

videos.title: Chosen, Yet Yearning for More

devotions.title: Moses at Kadesh: When God Said Speak
devotions.subject: Moses strikes the rock at Kadesh: trusting God’s instruction and honouring His holiness
devotions.keyVerse: “But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, ‘Because you did not trust me enough to demonstrate my holiness to the people of Israel, you will not lead them into the land I am giving them!’”
devotions.summary: God tells Moses to speak to the rock at Kadesh, but Moses strikes it in anger. Reflect on faithful obedience, gentle words under pressure, and the mercy of Christ, our Rock.

videos.title: He Was Right. He Said It in Anger. | Numbers 20

devotions.prayer: Faithful God, You gave water at Marah, at Horeb and at Kadesh, even when Your people complained and Your servant failed. Teach us to listen to what You have actually said. Guard our mouths when we are tired and provoked, and keep us from taking the glory that belongs to You. Thank You, Jesus, for being the Rock who was offered once for us. We come to You now, not with blows, but with a request: forgive us, make our hearts teachable and our words gentle, and let our lives show Your holiness. Amen.

devotions.title: When the Donkey Saw What the Prophet Could Not
devotions.subject: Balaam and the donkey
devotions.keyVerse: “Then the LORD opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the roadway with a drawn sword in his hand.”
devotions.summary: Balaam’s donkey saw what the prophet could not. Reflect on Numbers 22 and the mercy of God’s correction when desire blinds the heart.

videos.title: When the Donkey Saw What the Prophet Could Not

devotions.title: Seen from a Distance
devotions.subject: The death of Moses, God’s everlasting care, and promises fulfilled in Christ
devotions.keyVerse: “The eternal God is your refuge, and his everlasting arms are under you.”
devotions.summary: Moses sees the Promised Land from a distance and entrusts his life to God. Reflect on forgiveness when consequences remain, serving faithfully through disappointment, and the hope Jesus brings beyond the grave.

videos.title: He Never Entered the Promised Land. Then He Did. | Moses

devotions.prayer: Eternal God, thank You for being our refuge and for holding us in Your everlasting arms. Thank You for forgiving our sins, even when their consequences remain. We bring You the prayers You have not answered as we hoped. Teach us to trust Your goodness, to serve faithfully and to encourage those who will follow us. Help us to finish well. Thank You for Jesus, who has broken the power of death and holds our future. Keep our eyes on Him until we see Your promises fulfilled. In Jesus’ name we pray. Amen.

devotions.title: Faith That Keeps Marching
devotions.subject: Six silent days around Jericho
devotions.keyVerse: “It was by faith that the people of Israel marched around Jericho for seven days, and the walls came crashing down.”
devotions.summary: The fall of Jericho in Joshua 6 encourages patient obedience and trust in God before we can see the outcome.

videos.title: Six Days And The Wall Still Stood

devotions.keyVerse: “The Lord again raised up a rescuer to save them.”
devotions.summary: Read Judges 3 and reflect on Israel’s cry for help, God’s mercy, and the deliverance that calls His people back to Him.

videos.title: They Turned From God Many Times—Yet He Still Sent a Rescuer

devotions.summary: Walk with Naomi and Ruth through grief, loyal love, and unexpected provision. A devotion on finding hope when life feels empty.

devotions.keyVerse: “Hannah was in deep anguish, crying bitterly as she prayed to the LORD.”
devotions.summary: Hannah’s prayer in 1 Samuel 1 shows us how to bring deep anguish honestly to God and entrust our burdens to Him.

videos.title: A Battle Fought Without Fighting Back

devotions.title: Anointed, But Not Yet Appointed
devotions.subject: David, the oil and the long wait
devotions.keyVerse: “So as David stood there among his brothers, Samuel took the flask of olive oil he had brought and anointed David with the oil. And the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon David from that day on.”
devotions.summary: David’s anointing in 1 Samuel 16 begins a long wait. Reflect on God’s timing, faithful service, and trust in unfinished seasons.

videos.title: Are You Allowing God To Fulfill It?

devotions.title: When God Sends a Peacemaker
devotions.subject: Abigail rides out to meet David
devotions.keyVerse: “Praise the Lord, the God of Israel, who has sent you to meet me today!”
devotions.summary: Abigail’s courage in 1 Samuel 25 shows how wise words and humble action can interrupt anger and make room for peace.

videos.title: 400 Swords Came for Revenge - One Woman Stopped Them

devotions.title: An Understanding Heart
devotions.subject: Solomon asks, and two mothers come
devotions.keyVerse: “Give me an understanding heart so that I can govern your people well and know the difference between right and wrong.”
devotions.summary: Solomon asks for wisdom in 1 Kings 3. Reflect on listening to God, discerning what is right, and caring for the people entrusted to us.

videos.title: Both Claimed the Child—One Wanted Him Alive

devotions.title: When Another Voice Contradicts God
devotions.subject: The man of God from Judah
devotions.keyVerse: “But the man of God said to the king, ‘Even if you gave me half of everything you own, I would not go with you. I would not eat or drink anything in this place. For the Lord gave me this command: You must not eat or drink anything while you are there, and do not return to Judah by the same way you came.’”
devotions.summary: The man of God in 1 Kings 13 reminds us to test persuasive voices against what God has said and remain faithful to His Word.

videos.title: He Stood Up to a King—Then Believed a Lie

devotions.title: When Enough Is Not Enough
devotions.subject: Ahab, Naboth and one vineyard
devotions.keyVerse: “So Ahab went home angry and sullen because of Naboth’s answer. The king went to bed with his face to the wall and refused to eat!”
devotions.summary: Ahab and Naboth’s vineyard in 1 Kings 21 expose the danger of coveting. Reflect on contentment, justice, and the desires we nurture.

videos.title: Ahab Had a Kingdom - Yet He Was Miserable

devotions.title: God Sees Your Generosity
devotions.subject: The Shunammite builds a room
devotions.keyVerse: “We appreciate the kind concern you have shown us. What can we do for you?”
devotions.summary: The Shunammite woman’s hospitality in 2 Kings 4 invites us to practise thoughtful generosity and care without seeking recognition.

videos.title: Blessed Is The Hand That Gives
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: When Pride Bows to the Word of God
devotions.subject: Naaman at the Jordan
devotions.keyVerse: “Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something very difficult … So Naaman went down … and dipped himself seven times …”
devotions.summary: Naaman’s encounter with God’s word in 2 Kings 5 invites us to lay down pride and receive grace with humble faith.

videos.title: When Help Comes From the Unexpected
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: There’s More With You Than Against You
devotions.subject: Elisha's servant at Dothan
devotions.keyVerse: “Don’t be afraid!” Elisha told him. “For there are more on our side than on theirs!”
devotions.summary: Elisha’s servant in 2 Kings 6 learns to see beyond fear. Reflect on prayer, God’s presence, and courage when you feel outnumbered.

videos.title: When The Count Is Against Us
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: When Hezekiah Turned His Face to the Wall
devotions.subject: A king told he would die
devotions.keyVerse: “When Hezekiah heard this, he turned his face to the wall and prayed to the Lord.”
devotions.summary: Hezekiah turns to God in 2 Kings 20. Reflect on honest prayer, dependence, and bringing frightening news into God’s presence.

videos.title: A Death Sentence Reversed in the Courtyard

devotions.title: When God’s Word Was Found Again
devotions.subject: Josiah and the rediscovery of the Book of the Law
devotions.keyVerse: “The king took his place of authority beside the pillar and renewed the covenant in the LORD’s presence… and all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.”
devotions.summary: When the Book of the Law was found, Josiah listened with humility and acted. Reflect on receiving God’s Word and letting Christ reshape our choices.

videos.title: They Repaired the Temple. They Found a Book.

devotions.title: The Hidden Treasure: The Kingdom Worth Everything
devotions.subject: The hidden treasure and the priceless worth of Christ and His kingdom
devotions.keyVerse: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure that a man discovered hidden in a field. In his excitement, he hid it again and sold everything he owned to get enough money to buy the field.”
devotions.summary: Jesus’ parable of the hidden treasure invites us to recognise the worth of His kingdom. Reflect on finding Christ in Scripture, receiving His grace, and responding with joyful surrender.

videos.title: He Sold Everything—What Did He Find?

devotions.prayer: Heavenly Father, open our hearts to the treasure of Your Word. Help us recognise the worth of knowing Jesus and receive the grace He freely gives. Forgive us for allowing lesser things to claim first place in our lives. Give us willing hearts to trust You, obey Your Word, and surrender what keeps us from following You wholeheartedly. Sustain us when obedience is difficult, and deepen our joy in belonging to Christ. In Jesus’ name, amen.

devotions.title: The Man Jesus Set Free
devotions.subject: Jesus restores and sends the man from the Gerasenes
devotions.keyVerse: “Go home to your family, and tell them everything the Lord has done for you and how merciful he has been.”
devotions.summary: Jesus meets a man no one else could restrain, restores him, and sends him home to tell what the Lord has done. Reflect on Christ’s mercy and the testimony it gives us.

videos.title: He Broke Every Chain. He Was Still Not Free.

devotions.title: Job: Faith When Everything Is Taken Away
devotions.subject: Job’s faith, grief, and love for God amid loss and unanswered questions
devotions.keyVerse: “The LORD gave me what I had, and the LORD has taken it away. Praise the name of the LORD!”
devotions.summary: Job worships amid devastating loss and brings his anguish to God. Reflect on faith that can grieve, love for God beyond His gifts, and compassionate care for those who suffer.

videos.title: He Lost Everything… Then He Worshipped. | Job

devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for who You are. Teach us to love You and not only Your gifts. When we lose what we hold dear, let us bring You our tears and our worship. When we do not understand, help us trust Your heart. Make us gentle with others who suffer. Keep our eyes on Jesus, our Saviour, and give us grace for the next faithful step. Amen.

devotions.title: Can These Bones Live?
devotions.subject: The valley of dry bones
devotions.keyVerse: “Son of man, can these bones become living people again?” “O Sovereign Lord,” I replied, “you alone know the answer to that.”
devotions.summary: Ezekiel 37 speaks hope into despair. Reflect on God’s Word, the life His Spirit gives, and renewal that we cannot create ourselves.

videos.title: They Looked Alive… But Weren’t
The Bones Came Together. Still No Breath. | Ezekiel 37

devotions.title: Faith That Will Not Bow
devotions.subject: Three men and the blazing furnace
devotions.keyVerse: “If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God whom we serve is able to save us. He will rescue us from your power, Your Majesty. But even if he doesn’t, we want to make it clear to you, Your Majesty, that we will never serve your gods or worship the gold statue you have set up.”
devotions.summary: The three men in Daniel 3 choose faithfulness in the furnace. Reflect on trusting God even when the outcome is uncertain.

videos.title: They Chose The Furnace

devotions.title: Daniel Prayed Anyway
devotions.subject: A decree against prayer
devotions.keyVerse: “But when Daniel learned that the law had been signed, he went home and knelt down as usual in his upstairs room, with its windows open toward Jerusalem. He prayed three times a day, just as he had always done, giving thanks to his God.”
devotions.summary: Daniel 6 reveals a life rooted in daily prayer. Reflect on faithful habits, courage, and trusting God under pressure.

videos.title: His Only “Crime” Was Prayer

devotions.title: Jonah: When God's Mercy Is Bigger Than Our Plans
devotions.subject: Jonah, Nineveh, repentance, and God's compassion
devotions.keyVerse: “But Nineveh has more than 120,000 people living in spiritual darkness, not to mention all the animals. Shouldn’t I feel sorry for such a great city?”
devotions.summary: Jonah ran from God's call, received a second chance, and struggled when Nineveh received mercy too. Reflect on repentance, obedience, and sharing God's compassion.

videos.title: The Fish Wasn't the End of Jonah's Story | Jonah 4

devotions.prayer: Merciful God, thank You for Your patience with Jonah and with me. When I resist Your call, draw me back to You. When I value my comfort or reputation above people, help me see them as You do. Thank You, Jesus, for coming to seek the lost and giving Your life for sinners like me. Give me courage to obey Your Word and compassion to love the people You love. Amen.

devotions.title: Clothed by Grace: Joshua Before the Angel
devotions.subject: Joshua the high priest, the accuser, and God’s gift of clean garments
devotions.keyVerse: “See, I have taken away your sins, and now I am giving you these fine new clothes.”
devotions.summary: Joshua stood accused in filthy garments, but God took away his sins and clothed him anew. Reflect on forgiveness, Christ’s righteousness, and faithful service.

videos.title: He Stood Accused. God Changed His Clothes.

devotions.prayer: Father, thank You that the accuser does not have the last word over Your children. Give me honest repentance and keep me from despair. Thank You, Lord Jesus, for taking away what I could never wash out and for clothing me in Your righteousness. Now give me grace to walk in Your ways and serve You faithfully today. Amen.

devotions.title: The Unforgiving Servant: When Mercy Received Becomes Mercy Shared
devotions.subject: The parable of the unforgiving servant and mercy received becoming mercy shared
devotions.keyVerse: “Shouldn’t you have mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you?”
devotions.summary: Jesus tells of a servant forgiven an enormous debt who refuses mercy to another. Reflect on God’s grace, forgiving from the heart, and extending compassion while seeking safety and wise counsel where needed.

videos.title: They Hurt You Again. How Many Times Must You Forgive?

devotions.prayer: Heavenly Father, thank You for the debt You have cancelled through Jesus Christ—a debt we could never repay. Forgive us for dwelling on the wrongs of others while forgetting Your mercy towards us. Where we have been hurt, bring healing. Where we hold on to bitterness, help us let it go and leave justice in Your hands. Give us wisdom to seek safety when we need it, and grace to forgive from the heart. Let Your love flow through us to those around us. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

devotions.title: When Did We See You, Lord?
devotions.subject: Meeting Christ in the hungry, the stranger, the sick, and the forgotten
devotions.keyVerse: “And the King will say, ‘I tell you the truth, when you did it to one of the least of these my brothers and sisters, you were doing it to me!’”
devotions.summary: Jesus calls us to see Him in the people we might overlook. Reflect on Matthew 25, practical compassion, and the love His grace produces.

videos.title: They Served Jesus Without Knowing It

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for loving me before I had anything to give. Forgive me for the needs I have learned not to see. Open my eyes to the people You have placed within my reach, give me compassion and wisdom, and let Your love become visible in the way I treat them today. Amen.

devotions.title: When Jesus Saw Their Faith
devotions.subject: Four friends open a roof
devotions.keyVerse: “Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the paralyzed man, ‘My child, your sins are forgiven.’”
devotions.summary: Four friends bring a paralysed man to Jesus in Mark 2. Reflect on persistent faith, forgiveness, and carrying one another’s burdens.

videos.title: Faith That Opened a Roof
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: The Parable of the Sower: What Kind of Soil Is Your Heart?
devotions.subject: The parable of the sower and how we receive and hold on to God’s Word
devotions.keyVerse: “And the seeds that fell on the good soil represent honest, good-hearted people who hear God’s word, cling to it, and patiently produce a huge harvest.”
devotions.summary: Jesus’ parable of the sower shows one seed falling on four kinds of ground. Reflect on what happens to God’s Word after we hear it, and the hope that Jesus can change the soil of our hearts.

videos.title: The Seed Was the Same. The Soil Wasn't. | Luke 8
videos.uploadDateSource: https://youtube.com/shorts/zSKnJ1H1YZM (public YouTube uploadDate metadata verified 8 October 2026)

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for sowing Your Word in our hearts. Forgive us for hearing You and walking away unchanged. By Your Spirit, soften what is hard, deepen our roots in You, and clear away the cares that crowd You out. Help us hold on to Your Word and wait patiently for the fruit You grow. Amen.

devotions.title: The Transfiguration of Jesus
devotions.subject: Glory on the mountain, strength for the valley
devotions.keyVerse: “This is my Son, my Chosen One. Listen to him.”
devotions.summary: The disciples see Jesus’ glory and hear the Father’s call to listen to Him. Reflect on the cross, trusting His saving grace, and following Him in compassion for others.
devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for Your Son, Your Chosen One, who went to the cross for me and rose again. Help me listen to Him in Your Word. When the bright moments pass, keep me close to Jesus, and help me serve others in His love. Amen.

videos.title: God Spoke From the Cloud. Are You Listening?

devotions.title: One More Year: God's Mercy and the Call to Bear Fruit
devotions.subject: The barren fig tree, God’s patient mercy, repentance, and fruitful life in Christ
devotions.keyVerse: “Sir, give it one more chance. Leave it another year, and I’ll give it special attention and plenty of fertilizer.”
devotions.summary: Jesus’ parable of the barren fig tree joins a call to repentance with a plea for mercy. Reflect on God’s patient care and the fruit His grace grows as we remain close to Him.

videos.title: Three Years. Not One Fig. Still He Pleaded. | Luke 13

devotions.prayer: Father, thank You for Your patience with us. Thank You, Jesus, for pleading for us and caring for us when we have given You so little fruit. Keep us from judging others in their pain. Turn our hearts to You today, and let Your Spirit grow love, honesty and kindness in us, so that our lives bless the people around us. Amen.

devotions.title: The One Who Came Back
devotions.subject: Jesus heals ten lepers and the grateful Samaritan returns to thank Him
devotions.keyVerse: “Didn’t I heal ten men? Where are the other nine?”
devotions.summary: Jesus heals ten men, and one returns to thank Him. Reflect on the grateful Samaritan, remembering God’s goodness, and responding to freely given grace with praise and gratitude.

videos.title: God Answered Your Prayer. Did You Come Back?

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for hearing our cries for mercy. Forgive us for the times we have received Your gifts and carried on without returning to thank You. Open our hearts to Your grace, as You opened the heart of the man who returned. Teach us to remember Your goodness, praise You with joy, and tell others what You have done. Thank You for giving Yourself freely for us, before we ever thought to thank You. In Your name we pray. Amen.

devotions.title: When Peter Denied Jesus
devotions.subject: The promise, the fire and the look
devotions.keyVerse: “But I have pleaded in prayer for you, Simon, that your faith should not fail.”
devotions.summary: Peter’s denial in Luke 22 invites honest reflection on failure, repentance, and the grace of Jesus that calls us back.

videos.title: Has the Rooster Crowed in Your Life?

devotions.title: Remember Me
devotions.subject: The dying man who saw a King
devotions.keyVerse: “Jesus, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
devotions.summary: The dying man beside Jesus in Luke 23 turns to Him in faith. Reflect on mercy, salvation, and hope found in Christ.

videos.title: They Saw a Criminal—He Saw a King

devotions.title: When Jesus Walks With Us Unrecognized
devotions.subject: The road to Emmaus
devotions.keyVerse: “As they talked and discussed these things, Jesus himself suddenly came and began walking with them. But God kept them from recognizing him.”
devotions.summary: On the road to Emmaus in Luke 24, Jesus meets discouraged disciples. Reflect on Scripture, hope, and His presence in our confusion.

videos.title: When You Can’t See Jesus—But He’s Still There

devotions.title: I Have No One
devotions.subject: Thirty-eight years at Bethesda
devotions.keyVerse: “When Jesus saw him and knew he had been ill for a long time, he asked him, ‘Would you like to get well?’”
devotions.summary: Jesus meets a lonely man at Bethesda in John 5. Reflect on His compassion and the invitation to respond when hope feels distant.

videos.title: A Waiting Room Without A Doctor
videos.uploadDateSource: Channel Performance Index.md; YouTube Studio export recorded 2 September 2026

devotions.title: When Thomas Doubted
devotions.subject: Proof on his own terms
devotions.keyVerse: “Blessed are those who believe without seeing me.”
devotions.summary: Jesus meets Thomas in John 20. Reflect on honest questions, the testimony of Scripture, and learning to trust the risen Christ.

videos.title: He Demanded Proof. The Answer Had Wounds.

devotions.title: A Gift That Cannot Be Bought
devotions.subject: Simon in Samaria, the gift of the Holy Spirit, and the motives behind our service
devotions.keyVerse: “May your money be destroyed with you for thinking God’s gift can be bought!”
devotions.summary: Simon tries to buy the power to give the Holy Spirit, and Peter calls him to repent. Reflect on the motives behind our faith, the grace Christ freely gives, and serving others with a humble heart.

videos.title: He Was Baptized—Then Tried to Buy God’s Power

devotions.prayer: Heavenly Father, thank You for the gifts You freely give us through Jesus Christ—gifts no money can buy. Search our hearts and show us where we have sought Your blessing without seeking You. Forgive our pride, our desire to be noticed, and every selfish motive in our service. Create in us a clean heart and renew a loyal spirit within us. Fill us with Your Holy Spirit, not to make us great, but to make Jesus known. Teach us to give as freely as we have received and to serve others with humble, grateful hearts. Thank You for the price Jesus paid so that we could receive Your grace. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

devotions.title: Philip and the Ethiopian: When God Leads Us to One Soul
devotions.subject: Philip guides an Ethiopian seeker through Scripture to Jesus, baptism, and lasting joy
devotions.keyVerse: “So beginning with this same Scripture, Philip told him the Good News about Jesus.”
devotions.summary: God leads Philip from a city to one searching traveller on a desert road. Reflect on listening with care, explaining Scripture, and helping others discover the good news of Jesus.

videos.title: He Left a City Full of Joy for One Stranger

devotions.prayer: Heavenly Father, thank You for knowing every searching heart and for revealing Your love through Jesus Christ. Give us Philip’s willingness to obey, his readiness to listen, and his care for one person at a time. When we open the Scriptures, help us lead others to the Saviour rather than to ourselves. Encourage those who are seeking truth, guide those considering baptism, and make our church a loving home where faith can grow. Show each of us someone we can serve this week. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

devotions.title: Stopped by Grace: Saul on the Road to Damascus
devotions.subject: Saul encounters Jesus and Ananias welcomes him as a brother
devotions.keyVerse: “But the Lord said, ‘Go, for Saul is my chosen instrument to take my message to the Gentiles and to kings, as well as to the people of Israel.’”
devotions.summary: Jesus meets Saul on the road to Damascus and gives his life a new direction. Reflect on surrender, the mercy of Christ, and the courage to welcome someone His grace has reached.

videos.title: He Came to Arrest Believers. Jesus Stopped Him.

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, stop me when I am sure of myself but wrong. Open my eyes to who You are. Thank You for mercy that reaches even the worst sinner. Give me courage like Ananias, humility like Saul, and the faith to take the next step You give me. Amen.

devotions.title: A Life That Left Evidence
devotions.subject: Dorcas, and the coats she had made
devotions.keyVerse: “There was a believer in Joppa named Tabitha (which in Greek is Dorcas). She was always doing kind things for others and helping the poor.”
devotions.summary: Tabitha’s life in Acts 9 shows faith through practical kindness. Reflect on generosity, service, and the people our love reaches.

videos.title: A Life That Left Evidence

devotions.title: Lydia: A Businesswoman Whose Heart and Home Were Open to God
devotions.subject: Lydia’s conversion, baptism, hospitality, and partnership in the gospel
devotions.keyVerse: “One of them was Lydia from Thyatira, a merchant of expensive purple cloth, who worshiped God. As she listened to us, the Lord opened her heart, and she accepted what Paul was saying.”
devotions.summary: The Lord opens Lydia’s heart as she listens to the gospel, and she opens her home. Reflect on God’s grace, attentive faith, hospitality, and encouraging others with what we already have.

videos.title: Before She Opened Her Home, God Opened Her Heart

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for leading Your messengers to a quiet riverbank and for opening Lydia's heart to the Good News. Open our hearts, too. Help us to listen attentively to Your Word and to believe it gladly. Thank You that we are saved by Your grace, not by anything we own or achieve. Show us how to use what You have already given us to welcome, encourage and strengthen others wisely and safely. Make our hearts and our homes places where Your love is seen. Amen.

devotions.title: Praise in the Midnight
devotions.subject: Paul and Silas sing in the stocks
devotions.keyVerse: “Around midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening.”
devotions.summary: Paul and Silas pray and sing in Acts 16. Reflect on worship in suffering, faithful witness, and care for others in the dark.

videos.title: A Prison Break Nobody Took

devotions.title: Search the Scriptures
devotions.subject: The Bereans search day after day
devotions.keyVerse: “And the people of Berea were more open-minded than those in Thessalonica, and they listened eagerly to Paul’s message. They searched the Scriptures day after day to see if Paul and Silas were teaching the truth.”
devotions.summary: The Bereans in Acts 17 welcome the message and examine Scripture. Reflect on a faith that listens carefully and tests what it hears.

videos.title: Eager Hearts Search Scripture

devotions.title: A Name That Cannot Be Borrowed
devotions.subject: The sons of Sceva, the sacredness of Jesus’ name, and faith that is our own
devotions.keyVerse: “I know Jesus, and I know Paul, but who are you?”
devotions.summary: The sons of Sceva try to use Jesus’ name without knowing Him. Reflect on personal faith, reverence for Christ, and the Ephesian believers who let go of their former practices in response to His grace.

videos.title: They Used Jesus’ Name—And It Failed Them

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You that Your name is above every name and that You came to save us. Forgive us for the times we have spoken Your name without truly trusting You. Forgive us, too, for relying on someone else’s faith when You invite us to come to You ourselves. We long to know You and to be known by You. Show us whatever we are holding on to that draws our hearts away from You. Give us the courage to bring it into Your light and let it go. Thank You that, through the cross, You have won the victory over every power of darkness. Teach us to honour Your name in all we do, and help us rejoice that our names are written in heaven. In Your name we pray. Amen.

devotions.title: Courage in the Storm
devotions.subject: Fourteen nights without sun or stars
devotions.keyVerse: “So take courage! For I believe God. It will be just as he said.”
devotions.summary: Paul’s voyage in Acts 27 offers encouragement for uncertain times: trust God’s promises and bring practical hope to the people beside you.

videos.title: All Hope Was Gone - Then He Stood Up

devotions.title: Grace Greater Than the Thorn: Paul's Strength in Weakness
devotions.subject: Paul’s thorn and the sustaining grace of Christ in weakness
devotions.keyVerse: “My grace is all you need. My power works best in weakness.”
devotions.summary: Paul asks for relief from his thorn and receives Christ’s assurance of grace. Reflect on honest prayer, dependence on Jesus, and sharing one another’s burdens while difficulties remain.

videos.title: Weak… Yet Strong?

devotions.prayer: Lord Jesus, You know the requests we keep bringing to You. We ask for relief and help according to Your will. Sustain us with Your grace while we wait. Forgive our sins, strengthen our trust, and help us receive care without shame. Teach us to share the burdens of others with patience and love. Keep our hope in You, and guide our next faithful step. Amen.
